## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Paths — derived functions for IPath
//
// Bodies for the `IPath` interface declared in `paths.concepts.plato`: anything
// presentable as a vector `Path2D` via `ToPath`. The helpers are structural
// summaries that read the resulting path's contour list (an Array, hence
// ICountable). Pure expressions only; all inputs are immutable and evaluation is
// side-effect free. See `README.md` for naming and unit conventions.

library Paths
{
    //==
    // # IPath
    //
    // Anything presentable as a vector Path2D via ToPath. Structural summaries
    // read the resulting path's contour list (an Array, hence ICountable).

    // The number of contours in the presented path.
    ContourCount(self: IPath): Integer
        => self.ToPath.Contours.Count;

    // True when the presented path has no contours (draws nothing).
    IsEmpty(self: IPath): Boolean
        => self.ToPath.Contours.Count == 0;

    // True when the presented path has at least one contour.
    IsNotEmpty(self: IPath): Boolean
        => self.ToPath.Contours.Count > 0;
}
```
